in_hebrew.name: Kile

in_latin.name: Kile
in_latin.long_meaning: Kile est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'kileos', meaning 'strong, powerful, or sturdy'. In Christian tradition, this name may be associated with the strength and power of God.
